zh: 上周末我去看爷爷奶奶，他们做了很多好吃的。
old_en: Last weekend, I visited my grandparents, and they made lots of delicious food.
new_en: Last weekend, I visited my grandparents, and they made lots of yummy food.

zh: 去年夏天我们全家去了海边，玩得很开心。
old_en: Last summer, we all went to the seaside and had great fun.
new_en: Last summer, our whole family went to the seaside and had a great time.

zh: 上周我把钥匙弄丢了，最后在沙发下面找到。
old_en: Last week, I lost my keys and eventually found them under the sofa.
new_en: Last week, I lost my keys and finally found them under the sofa.

zh: 上周出门时发现钥匙不见了，我找了一个下午。
old_en: Last week, I realized my keys were missing when I left home, so I searched all afternoon.
new_en: Last week, I left home and realized my keys were missing, so I searched all afternoon.

zh: 今天早上我起晚了，上班迟到了十分钟。
old_en: This morning, I overslept and was ten minutes late for work.
new_en: This morning, I overslept and was ten minutes late for work.

zh: 今天早上路上堵车，我到公司时已经九点半了。
old_en: This morning, there was heavy traffic, and I arrived at the company at half past nine.
new_en: This morning, there was heavy traffic, and I got to the office at 9:30.

zh: 上个月我们搬了新家，离地铁站很近。
old_en: Last month, we moved to a new place near the subway station.
new_en: Last month, we moved to a new home near the subway station.

zh: 上个月搬家时朋友都来帮忙，一天就搬完了。
old_en: Last month, friends helped us move, so we finished in one day.
new_en: Last month, friends helped us move, and we finished in one day.

zh: 昨天晚上和朋友看电影，散场后还聊了很久。
old_en: Last night, I went to the movies with friends, and we chatted for a long time after.
new_en: Last night, I watched a movie with friends and chatted for a long time after the movie.

zh: 上周我给妈妈打了个电话，她最近身体很好。
old_en: Last week, I called my mom, who's been doing well recently.
new_en: Last week, I called my mom, and she's been doing well recently.

zh: 上周日我给妈妈打电话，说了半个小时。
old_en: Last Sunday, I called my mom and talked for half an hour.
new_en: Last Sunday, I called my mom and talked for half an hour.

zh: 昨天在餐厅我们点了一桌子菜，最后没吃完。
old_en: Yesterday at the restaurant, we ordered a table of dishes, but left most of them uneaten.
new_en: Yesterday at the restaurant, we ordered lots of dishes but couldn't finish them all.

zh: 上周末我和妹妹去看爷爷奶奶，还带了一盒水果。
old_en: Last weekend, I went to see my grandparents with my sister and brought a box of fruits.
new_en: Last weekend, I visited my grandparents with my sister and brought a box of fruit.

zh: 昨天开会时我的电脑突然坏了，只好借同事的。
old_en: Yesterday, my computer broke while in the meeting, so I had to use my colleague's.
new_en: Yesterday, my computer broke during the meeting, so I had to borrow a colleague's.

zh: 昨天开会时电脑突然黑屏，大家都停下来等我。
old_en: The computer went black during yesterday's meeting, so everyone stopped waiting for me.
new_en: Yesterday, the computer went black during the meeting, so everyone stopped to wait for me.

zh: 前天我在超市遇到一位老同学，我们聊了很久。
old_en: The day before yesterday, I met an old classmate in the supermarket and chatted for a long time.
new_en: The day before yesterday, I met an old classmate in the supermarket and chatted for a long time.

zh: 去年夏天我在海边住了三天，每天都去游泳。
old_en: Last summer, I stayed by the seaside for three days and swam every day.
new_en: Last summer, I stayed by the seaside for three days and swam every day.

zh: 昨天请朋友吃饭，我点了一桌子菜，他特别高兴。
old_en: I ordered a lot of dishes yesterday, and he was particularly happy.
new_en: Yesterday, I invited a friend to dinner and ordered lots of dishes, which made him very happy.

zh: 前天在超市遇到老同学，我差点没认出他来。
old_en: The day before yesterday, I met an old classmate in the supermarket and almost didn't recognize him.
new_en: The day before yesterday, I met an old classmate in the supermarket and almost didn't recognize him.

zh: 昨天晚上我看了一部老电影，看到十二点才睡。
old_en: Last night, I watched an old movie until midnight before sleeping.
new_en: Last night, I watched an old movie until midnight and went to bed.
